_about: Session 1157 (chain 077): the stored example answers of the Ask panel on /grid, by grid. Each is an answer a recorded evaluation graded right, with every figure traced to the tool result it came from (table, filter, the run's date). No model call wrote or reads this file. Written by site/scripts/build-grid-ask-examples.mjs from the files named in `files`; lib/gridask.ts applies the license holds of lib/license.ts on the day the page is drawn.

files.left_out: the run recorded the count of tool calls, not their results, so no figure of it can be traced to a tool result

examples.question: How much wind did CAISO curtail in total in 2024, in MWh?
examples.answer: CAISO curtailed about 230,777 MWh of wind in calendar year 2024 (230776.644 MWh, rounded). This is the sum of 12 monthly values of curtailed_wind_mwh for entity caiso:ISO, from January to December 2024 (iso_curtailment_monthly, derived from CAISO's curtailment reports). Months are in local time. This is CAISO's own curtailment figure, which isn't comparable with other ISOs' figures.

examples.run: session 302's evaluation, asked 2026-10-19 through POST /api/ask, the grid's own chat
examples.question: What is the lowest monthly carbon intensity of CAISO's generation in the warehouse, and in which month?
examples.answer: The lowest monthly carbon intensity of CAISO generation in the warehouse is 44.2145 kgCO2/MWh, in May 2026 (intensity_generation, entity eia930:CISO, UTC month start 2026-05-01, which is 1 May 2026 Pacific). This comes from carbon_intensity_monthly, which is derived (computed by the ERW). It is the minimum of 69 monthly values from August 2018 to July 2026. Pacific-local month labels are the same as UTC here. The next-lowest months are June 2026 at 48.2772 kgCO2/MWh and then the pre-2026 low of 94.5725 kgCO2/MWh in May 2019 (all carbon_intensity_monthly). The table's source report says the CAISO series is built from a join made on 16 December 2025. The 2026 values are far below every earlier month. This may partly reflect that data break, so treat the comparison with caution.

examples.question: What was the load-weighted real-time price at CAISO's SP15 hub in September 2024?
examples.answer: The load-weighted real-time price at CAISO's SP15 hub (TH_SP15_GEN-APND) for September 2024 was 33.07 USD/MWh (cost_of_power_monthly, derived). It is the hourly real-time price weighted by CAISO's hourly demand, for the Pacific-time month. The month is complete: 720 real-time hours out of 720 hours in the month (cost_of_power_monthly). For comparison, a flat load paid a simple mean of 31.38 USD/MWh (cost_of_power_monthly), so the shape premium was 1.68 USD/MWh (cost_of_power_monthly). This covers wholesale energy only, with no transmission, distribution, capacity or taxes.

examples.run: session 267's evaluation, asked 2026-10-14 through POST /api/ask, the general chat of /ask
examples.question: What was the average real-time shape premium at NYISO's N.Y.C. zone over the twelve months of 2025?
examples.answer: The mean of the twelve monthly real-time shape premiums at NYISO N.Y.C. for January to December 2025 is 4.36 USD/MWh (cost_of_power_monthly, variable rt_shape_premium, derived table, an unweighted mean of 12 monthly values). Monthly values range from 0.99 USD/MWh (May) to 19.74 USD/MWh (June). Treat the figure with caution, because no month is complete. Real-time hours held total 8256 against 8760 hours in the year (cost_of_power_monthly). For example, February has 600 of 672 hours, and July has 648 of 744. Months are local operating months. The table is derived and public. The shape premium is the load-weighted price minus the simple-mean price.
